run_mephisto_flask_server: run the mephisto flask websocket server on port 3000 using gevent
start_websocket_server: start a gevent websocket server with the mephisto router blueprint and flask app
configure_server_port: configure the mephisto flask server port via the PORT environment variable
register_mephisto_blueprint: register the mephisto router blueprint on a flask app with url prefix
setup_gevent_monkey_patch: setup gevent monkey patching for async support in the mephisto flask server
